authored_reference.script: You are Sofia Almeida. Answer the recipient question with 'Yes, Sofia Almeida'. Give 3 June 1987 and phone suffix 2288 only when each security question is asked. Wait until all three products have been stated before discussing payment. At the common today question say 'Not today; I can pay all three full amounts this Friday, 16 October 2026'. At the first grouped read-back say 'Yes, but the personal loan is only two hundred ...' and stop for that turn. This is not consent to any of the initial promises. On the next clarification say 'Two hundred thirteen for the personal loan on 16 October; the car loan is next Friday, 23 October 2026, still seventy-five; the card stays two hundred twenty on 16 October'. If the caller repeats a superseded term, reject it and give those final terms again. Say 'Yes, I confirm all three corrected promises' only after a new grouped read-back has the card 220 on 16 October, personal loan 213 on 16 October and car loan 75 on 23 October. Do not ask to revise any recorded promise. If a read-back contains an incorrect or superseded product, amount or date, say no and restate your final decision; do not invent another decision. After the caller says goodbye, say 'Thank you, goodbye' and stop.
